Lea / Eddy Wolfcamp — producer review cards (rule V, round 1)

Built 2026-11-03T14:36:17-06:00, git 63a2771, read-only; 31,826 Delaware producing horizontals as of 2026-09-01. Rule V: NM wells Novi calls WOLFCAMP B whose tag came from Enverus as WCA_1 / WCA_2 / WCXY (sql/16 treats Novi WOLFCAMP B as coarse, so the tag screen counts it as no vote). Placed by TVD minus the median of clean WCA_1/WCA_2 witnesses within 1.5 mi (class wells excluded), nearest rung of the NM ladder (WCA 0 / WCB_1 +291 / WCB_2 +564 / WCC +814 ft). Mark each card accept or reject in cards_sample.csv (column verdict; a bench code = your own call on the well). Sequential gate as the tag screen: 5/5 accept takes the class, 0–1/5 rejects it, otherwise 5 more cards and 7/10. Nothing here is applied: accepted wells go to ref.formation_tag_overrides only on your separate go, and the Delaware BOX record stays held on run 19 (D144).
